dialog: Show me what you're capable of.
If this battle was fate/ I pity your luck.
I am the eternal star of the battlefield!
Come on/ let's enjoy ourselves!
Most people run away from me/ screaming and crying/\n　so I must commend your bravery.
You're wasting my time!
I see you've got a death-wish!
Congratulations!\n　You've invited a vampire's wrath.
This is what happens when you challenge me.
Light work!
Another lamb to the slaughter.
You're hardly even worth my time.
Your fate is sealed!
Time for a little carnage!
This shouldn't take too long!
You're cruising for a bruising!
I was considering being merciful/ but I've changed my mind.
Behold/ the power of the lord of the night.
I hope you'll make a good warm-up/ at least...
It's time for Remilia's counterattack.
Time for me to get serious!
Fortune favors the bold/ and no one's more bold than me!
Turnabout is fair play/ for the both of us!
Heh. I suppose the game is afoot...
There!
Go!
Fly forth!
Here's your internship/ servants!
Take that!
Slice and dice!
Get out of my way!
Too slow!
Take this!
You've nowhere to run or hide!
See if you can handle this!
A gift of scarlet danmaku.\n Enjoy it!
Behold/ my danmaku!
This is how I handle things!
I condense down all my scarlet magic...
Into a form that can pierce anything...
Pierce through/ Gungnir!
This move will finish you off!
Gush forth/ blood-red magic!
A demonic lance that cannot be stopped...
Spear the Gungnir!
I'll hear your compliments in the afterlife!
Gather/ my magic...
Spear the Gungnir...
Spear the Gungnir... Fire!
Let's finish this.
In the name the lord of scarlet/ come forth!
The demonic spear/ Gungnir...
The demonic spear/ Gungnir... Fly!
It seems you are in desperate need of a reminder...\n of horrifying vampires can be!
Here!
Ultimately/ tricks or strategies are unneeded.\n My raw power will suffice.
Time to go all out!
I have you!
That was only one-tenth of my full power/ by the way.
As the mighty lord of the Scarlet Devil Mansion/\n I shall carve my name into your very bones!
No escape!
Accept your fate.
This the lord of the night's magic!
Rip and tear!
And in the end/ everything turns to scarlet.
I won't allow that.
I'll permit this transgression. This time.
This isn't particularly fun.
Enjoy this/ because it won't last long.
My magic can't reach?!
I didn't ask for you to do that!
Here's another for you!
Back off/ I'll handle them!
Your defeat is in the cards!
Ugh/ let ME handle this.
This too/ is the duty of a noblewoman.
I protected you on a whim. Be grateful.
I don't much enjoy being stuck behind you.
I'll lend you a hand.
I'll assist you. Relish the opportunity.
I'll take them down first/ if you're not quick about it.
Allow me to assist.
I'll leave you behind if you're too slow.
Let's take care of this one.
Time for a blood bath!
You can't escape this fate!
This ought to be fun!
What are you doing?! Patchy's going to be so mad at me!
Koakuma/ I offer you my praise/ for creating this opening.
Just go back to hiding behind Patchouli.
I owe Patchy one.
You're part of the Scarlet Devil Mansion/ as well.
I'll lend you a hand/ Koakuma.
Show me your good side/ Koakuma.
Don't slack off now/ Koakuma.
Koakuma/ we're taking this one down!
Why am I stuck behind you/ of all people?
Koakuma/ I'll permit you stand beside me/ just this once.
Show me what your magic can do/ Koakuma.
Time for a blood bath/ Koakuma!
Breaching my gate was an act of war!
Take five/ Meiling.
Fine work/ preparing this feast for me.
Excuse me/ isn't this YOUR job?
This is part of your benefits package.
You're the shield and I'm the spear/ you see?
If you think you're up for the challenge Meiling/ you can handle the rest.
Let's take care of this one/ Meiling.
Meiling/ handle the rest as you please.
Meiling/ we're taking this one down!
You're not satisfied just guarding my door/ right?
Meiling/ I'll permit you stand beside me/ just this once.
This ought to be fun/ Meiling!
How dare you harm Patchy...\n You'll pay a debt of blood for that!
Patchy... were you cutting corners again?
Leave the rest to me/ Patchy!
If you can't even dodge these/ you need to get some exercise.
Patchy/ look out!
I always trust your judgment/ Patchy.
Let's take care of this one/ Patchy.
Between Patchy and I/ we've got all the ranges covered.
Let's take them down/ Patchy!
Can you move a bit faster Patchy? I'm getting bored back here.
I'm not the type to laze about in the shade.
Don't lose the beat here/ Patchy!
This ought to be fun/ Patchy!
How dare you harm Sakuya...\n You'll pay a debt of blood for that!
Prepare a toast to our victory later/ would you?
A surprisingly shallow cut from you/ Sakuya.
Sakuya/ I'll take care of the rest!
Don't lay a finger on my maid.
That's not like you/ Sakuya.
With Sakuya here/ this should be easy.
Clean up after I'm done/ Sakuya.
When you're done being my opening act/ make sure to swap with me/ Sakuya.
Knives or claws/ which would you prefer?
Let's take them down/ Sakuya!
This ought to be fun/ Sakuya!
Don't lose the beat here/ Sakuya!
Use my time wisely/ Sakuya.
How dare you harm Flan...\n You'll pay a debt of blood for that!
My dignity as an older sister is on the line here!
Flan/ leave the rest to me!
I won't allow it!
Flan/ look out!
Twice the vampires means double the pain!
Flan/ handle the rest however you'd like.
Let's take care of this one/ Flan.
It's dangerous for you to out in front all the time.\n　We should swap/ after this.
Flan/ we're taking this one down!
Let's show them our danmaku/ Flan!
Stick close/ Flan!
This ought to be fun/ Flan!
I didn't expect Satori to put herself on the line for me...
Forget about the mind/ and focus on the body.
Satori/ leave the rest to me.
What happened to your mind-reading?
Take it from me/ you REALLY need to get outside and exercise more often.
You can read my mind/ right? So you should already know what to do.
I hate waiting around!
Let's take care of this one/ Satori.
This one? Sure/ I'll trust your judgment.
Try to keep up with me/ Satori!
This ought to be fun/ Satori!
Let's traumatize them a bit!
Now's the fated time/ Satori!
I can hardly believe Yuuka of all people actually protected me...
You didn't quite finish the job/ Yuuka.
Finders keepers/ Yuuka.
I'm sure this must be embarrassing for you/ Yuuka.
Pick up the pace/ Yuuka.
If you're too slow/ I'll leave you behind Yuuka.
Get on with it/ Yuuka.
Just swap with me already/ you slowpoke.
I trust your instincts/ if nothing else.
Let's take care of this one/ Yuuka.
Shall we see which one of is the most elegant?
This ought to be fun/ Yuuka.
Now's the fated time/ Yuuka!
That was as fate would have it"/ let's say.
This was inevitable.
That's roughly my speed/ if I get serious.
That's about what I'd expect/ from the likes of you.
Is that all? Try putting your back into it next time.
You dare challenge me/ when that's your best go?
Get serious.
Weak/ and boring to boot.
Crap/ they've got me cornered!
I might've played around a bit too much...
The lord of the night's vengeance will be swift!
Making me get serious/ are you?
Ugh... this sucks.
This... can't be happening!
My dignity is seriously in danger right now...
It would set a bad example if I lost here!
Buzz off/ you pest!
You're seriously ruining the mood!
Don't go celebrating over one lucky hit!
You make for a lousy dance partner!
Hey/ that's rude!
You're going to regret that!
What the?!\n That hurt/ you buffoon!
Your head will look lovely above my fireplace...!
Ngh! We'll see who gets the last laugh!
This is looking... kind of bad.
Guess I overdid it...
Oof... Don't mind/ just a little accident.
You're FAR too slow!
For a vampire's speed/ that's nothing.
Your supposed accuracy is irrelevant to me.
What a lovely workout.
Can't keep up with me? What a shame.
What a cute little show this has been.
I'm afraid you'll need more than guts to defeat me.
Did your hands shaking throw off your aim?
Lacking in cohesion/ I'd say.
If you're just relying on your eyes/ you'll never catch me.
That was as fate would have it"/ let's say.
If you have any cards left up your sleeves/ now would be the time.
An opening/ right... there!
An attack like that won't do it.
A straightforward... no/ a reckless attack.
This is my territory.
Silence/ mongrel.
Hyah!
Let me guess. You were so awe-struck by my Charisma/\n you just HAD to let me go first.
This is how it was meant to be.
But... I'm the lord of the night...
I won't forget this humiliation...
Ugh/ why'd this have to happen to me?! \n　Sakuyaaa! I want my tea!
I'll get you next time/ just wait and see!
...Yep/ I'm bored.\n　I'll hang back and enjoy the rest of the show.
I won't forget this humiliation...
No way... I lost?!
Put me back in/ I've got more fight left in me!
Not bad. The rest of you should be careful with this one.
Flan/ behave yourself!
Am I not even allowed to talk to you...?
At this rate/ Flan's...
At this rate/ Flan's...
Stop it/ Flan!
Stop it/ Flan!
Good for me that I'm used to fighting the sun.
I don't care much for you lot/ so I'm not holding back.
If you insist on playing so much/ then sure/ let's play!
You'll make a good warm up/ at least.
Try not to fry my parasol/ thanks.
You're rather slippery/ aren't you?
You put on airs/ with no basis in reality.
A sword that strikes one's weakpoints? Hmm/ bit of a bad match-up for a vampire...
Thanks for the show. I feel all the more justified in skewering you now.
Quite the display you've made here! I hope you've got the strength to back it up.
Still playing around/ hm? In that case...
You might not be up for it/ but I am.
You're in for as much pain/ as this incident has been for us!
I'll round up your whole flock/ right here!
What a lovely opportunity to cut loose!
You send some paltry nightmares to face the devil? Don't make me laugh!
So you're my doppelganger/ huh...\n　Shouldn't you be a bit taller?
We may have the same powers/ but our ways of using them couldn't be more different.
This is... unpleasant.
Can we not have someone else handle this one?
This time for real/ Yuuka!
I've been waiting a long time for this fight.
Genghis Khan's ready to go!
Borrowed power won't be enough to let you beat a vampire!
Yeah/ I'm really not feeling this anymore...
I hope you're ready for a bad time/ Makura.
Behold/ the power of the devil you've been dreaming of!
I'll dye your dreams blood-red!
I hope you're ready for a bad time/ Shitone.
Behold/ the power of the devil you've been dreaming of!
I'll dye your dreams blood-red!
I foresee the signs of your end!
You picked a fight with the wrong vampire!
O sigil of the Devil/ cleanse these fools with your judgment!
Divine Punishment... Star of David.
Wha—How is this happening?!
This match doesn't count! I demand a redo!
You think you're better than me? I think not!
Here!
Get a hold of yourself/ Flan!
Get a hold of yourself/ Flan!
Stop it/ Remi...
I told you not to come any closer!
...Tch!
I wanted us to be together/ but you never came for me!
I was always...
I was always... always...
Waiting for you!
...Flan!!
You will rue the day you invaded my castle.
Flow forth/ scarlet magic!
Carve your mark...
Into this arrogant fool!
...And thus/ I render the land Scarlet".
I'm not interested in the small fry.
Weakling/ get out of my way!
Lowly cretin. You can't even understand how outmatched you are.
Why aren't you quaking in fear of me?
Come forth/ power of the Scarlet Devil!
I'll turn you into a scarlet smear on the wall!
I'll take you all down myself!
This isn't particularly fun.
Come closer/ so I can tear you to pieces.
Hmm... Done playing around?
Luckily/ I don't care about you at all.
Not enough/ I'm afraid.
Is that all? Try putting your back into it next time.
Was that all?
Get serious.
Weak/ and boring to boot.
...You're pretty good.
I might've played around a bit too much...
Making me get serious/ are you?
Buzz off/ you pest!
Not bad.
I'll give you credit for that one.
You make for a lousy dance partner!
Your head will look lovely above my fireplace...!
Can't keep up with me? What a shame.
Did your hands shaking throw off your aim?
Lacking in cohesion/ I'd say.
That was as fate would have it"/ let's say.
Whoops. Don't want to get my clothes dirty...
